scope: Actual original full authored sources compiled shared with/without pinned spng; no PH_TESTING. Observer shim only reads first stored byte.
findings: 32 valid 1x1 PNG loads passed: four color types, grayscale enabled/disabled, memory/file, with/without spng. Width/height checked and all grayscale channel/first-byte values asserted.

Grayscale RGB/RGBA/GA inputs rejected by direct spng backend in v23 succeed via original public stb fallback, with red=76 and gray=128. Thus direct-backend failure is not public decode failure for these cases.
Default native-channel load differs: spng returns 3 channels for gray/GA/RGBA while stb preserves 1/2/4. Alpha dropped by original spng wrapper. No all-input equivalence or hash parity claim.
remaining: Broader native-channel and alpha recipe qualification
